title: Check: Trends in the Periodic Table (2) (B)

questions.stem: Why are the reactivity trends opposite in Group 1 and Group 7?

options.text: Group 1 elements are metals and Group 7 are non-metals with no connection
Group 1 metals lose electrons (easier further from nucleus) while Group 7 non-metals gain electrons (easier closer to nucleus)
Group 1 elements become smaller going down while Group 7 elements become larger

questions.explanation: Group 1 metals react by losing their outer electron, which becomes easier as atoms get larger (reactivity increases down). Group 7 non-metals react by gaining an electron, which becomes harder as atoms get larger (reactivity decreases down). Both trends relate to atomic size but the effect is opposite.
